name: Shunt references (TL431)
summary: A tiny adjustable voltage reference found in almost every switching power supply.
uses: Precise voltage references and battery monitors
Adjusting a power supply’s output voltage
identify: A three-legged TO-92 or tiny surface-mount part marked TL431 or just 431, near the optocoupler on power supply boards.
test: Join the reference pin to the cathode and feed it through a 1 kΩ resistor from 5–12V: the cathode should sit at about 2.5V.
